meta.name: add-discord
meta.description: Add Discord bot channel integration via Chat SDK.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 集成 Discord 机器人频道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加 Discord 机器人消息通道。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Discord bot channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add a Discord bot channel to your application.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会替你把 Discord 适配器代码复制进项目并注册,安装固定版本依赖,然后引导你在 Discord 开发者后台创建机器人、粘贴令牌、重启服务,让机器人能作为你的私信或服务器频道通道。这样你就能在 Discord 里和它对话了。
howto.when: 当你说要添加 Discord 机器人集成,或正在 /setup 配置流程中需要接入 Discord 频道时触发。

say.text: 请帮我添加 Discord 机器人集成
say.note: Claude 开始复制并注册适配器,引导你完成设置。

say.text: 把 Discord 通道接到这个项目上
say.note: 同样触发集成流程,需按提示提供 Bot Token。

say.text: 在 Discord 上开通和我的私信通道
say.note: 会引导你创建机器人并解析私信频道 ID。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude copies the Discord adapter code into your project, registers it, installs the pinned dependency, then walks you through creating a Discord bot, pasting its token, restarting the service, so the bot can serve as your DM or server-channel conversation channel.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add Discord bot integration or need to connect a Discord channel during the /setup configuration flow.

say_en.text: Please add the Discord bot integration to my project.
say_en.note: Claude starts copying and registering the adapter and guides you through setup.

say_en.text: Connect this project to a Discord channel.
say_en.note: Same integration flow; you'll need to provide the Bot Token.

say_en.text: Set up a Discord DM channel for me.
say_en.note: Guides you to create a bot and resolves the DM channel ID.
